lines.zh: 我挂在叶下，只能被风吹动
lines.en: I hang under the leaf; only the wind moves me.

lines.zh: 我一根丝粘着叶柄，走不了
lines.en: One thread ties me to the stem; I cannot walk.

lines.zh: 我想挪一寸，丝就绷紧了
lines.en: If I shift an inch, the thread pulls taut.
I turn slowly inside the shell.

lines.zh: 整片叶子被我一动就响
lines.en: The whole leaf rustles when I move.

lines.zh: 我挂在林子里，日夜不动
lines.en: I hang in the forest, still day and night.

lines.zh: 我的丝很细，却拽得动一片叶
lines.en: My silk is thin, yet it moves a leaf.

lines.zh: 我从叶背滑到叶缘，停住
lines.en: I slide from the leaf's back to its edge and stop.
On windy nights I swing all night.
I do not walk; I wait to become a moth.
My shell is sturdier than it looks.

lines.zh: 这个位置是我自己挑的
lines.en: I chose this spot myself.

lines.zh: 我从树冠的这边挪到了那边
lines.en: I shifted from one side of the canopy to the other.
I dare not loosen the thread; I would fall.

lines.zh: 叶子的背面晒不到太阳
lines.en: The leaf's underside sees no sun.
It is dark in the forest; that suits.

lines.zh: 我悬着，白色的丝在发亮
lines.en: I hang there, my white silk catching light.

lines.zh: 壳里的翅膀一层层叠着
lines.en: The wings inside are folded layer on layer.

lines.zh: 我能听见啄木鸟在敲树
lines.en: I can hear a woodpecker at work.
This outer skin has hardened.
A bug crawls over my thread.
I count the patches of light.

lines.zh: 我不需要吃东西，丝已经吐完了。
lines.en: I do not need to eat; the silk is all spun.
Even a small move costs much effort.
My color is much like the bark.

lines.zh: 雨落在叶上，我这边是干的
lines.en: Rain falls on the leaf; my side is dry.

lines.zh: 我在等一个晚上的温度
lines.en: I wait for the right night's warmth.
This leaf holds me.

lines.zh: 你从下面看我，我看得清
lines.en: You look up at me; I can see you.
Do not pick this leaf.

lines.zh: 我动不了，只能被你打量
lines.en: I cannot move; I can only be examined.

lines.zh: 我认得林子里每个来的人
lines.en: I know everyone who comes to this forest.
Your finger touched my silk.

lines.zh: 这一层壳里有活的东西
lines.en: There is something alive in this shell.

lines.zh: 我会变成一只很大的蛾
lines.en: I will become a very large moth.
Someone wants my silk.

lines.zh: 我在你手边，够不着也躲不开
lines.en: I am beside your hand, unable to reach or flee.

lines.zh: 等我出来，你还能认得我吗
lines.en: When I emerge, will you still know me?
My silk loosened; I swing hard.
A small hole appears in the shell.
Something inside moves urgently.

lines.zh: 我没有声音可以发出来
lines.en: I have no voice to make.
I cling to what silk remains.
That will delay me by days.
The shell has darkened.
This crack cannot be mended.
Do not move me again.
I do not eat; I am inside the shell.

lines.zh: 树叶不是给我的，是给毛虫的
lines.en: The leaves are for caterpillars, not me.

lines.zh: 你把叶子递过来，我用不上
lines.en: You offer a leaf, but I have no use for it.
One thread holds me; I cannot go.
You are too close; you block the wind.
I cannot smell that.

lines.zh: 我在等羽化，不是等食物
lines.en: I am waiting to emerge, not for food.
Do not shake this leaf.
Your hand is warm; I dislike it.
Leave it there; I will not move.
You touched me; the silk pulled taut.

lines.zh: 我撞到叶面，壳响了一声
lines.en: I hit the leaf and the shell knocks.
That nearly snapped the thread.
I have no strength to fight back.
The silk has loosened a little.
You step back, and I relax.
The leaf is creased from the pull.
I can only press to the leaf.

lines.zh: 我还在壳里，什么都做不了
lines.en: I am still in the shell; I can do nothing.
Wait until I am a moth.
There is only me in this cocoon.

lines.zh: 将来会有另一只，在同一个晚上
lines.en: Someday another will come, on the same night.

lines.zh: 我连自己的翅膀都还没见过
lines.en: I have not even seen my own wings.
I leave that for later.
The forest is quiet; good for waiting.

lines.zh: 同类的味道，我大概认得出
lines.en: I could probably recognize my own kind's scent.
I draw myself in and let it take time.

lines.zh: 时间会把我变成别的样子
lines.en: Time will turn me into something else.

lines.zh: 我抓不住东西，我只有丝
lines.en: I cannot grasp anything; I have only silk.
To take me, you must undo the silk.
Do not put me on the ground; I would be crushed.
Held by the thread, I swing badly.

lines.zh: 换一片叶子吧，这片旧了
lines.en: Choose another leaf; this one is old.
Once hung, do not move me again.

lines.zh: 丝粘在你手上，很难弄掉
lines.en: The silk sticks to your hand, hard to remove.
This move adds days to my wait.
You hung me higher; more wind.
I cling to the new leaf's underside.
I cannot see far; I can only listen.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在落叶上很响
lines.en: Your steps are loud on the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我认得取丝的人的手势
lines.en: I know the motion of someone after silk.

lines.zh: 这一片叶子是我的边界
lines.en: This leaf is my boundary.
I can only wait where I am.

lines.zh: 如果有什么靠近，我缩起来
lines.en: If anything comes close, I pull in.

lines.zh: 我想知道翅能不能撑开
lines.en: I wonder whether the wings will open.
To a bird, I am one mouthful.

lines.zh: 我在壳里，没什么能做的
lines.en: In the shell, there is nothing I can do.
I have memorized this position.
You are still nearby; I do not move.
I can hear you breathing.
The shell grows tighter.
These days matter.

lines.zh: 窗外的光变了，我知道时候近了
lines.en: The light has changed; I know the time is near.

lines.zh: 如果有人来取丝，我什么都做不了
lines.en: If someone comes for silk, there is nothing I can do.
I wait for that night.
Be quiet; I need quiet.
I have no way to attack.
Touch me and all I can do is sway.

lines.zh: 丝是我唯一的武器，也只是丝
lines.en: Silk is my only weapon, and it is only silk.

lines.zh: 壳能挡一下，挡不住第二下
lines.en: The shell blocks once, not twice.

lines.zh: 我缩在壳里，等这一下过去
lines.en: I curl in the shell and let it pass.
I have neither teeth nor venom.
If the thread breaks, I am finished.
I press myself flatter.
Your hand will be covered in silk.
A few more days and I could fly.

lines.zh: 毛虫在林子里把我结了出来
lines.en: A caterpillar spun me in the forest.

lines.zh: 我一开始只是一层薄丝
lines.en: I began as nothing but a thin layer of silk.

lines.zh: 这片叶背被我选了很久
lines.en: I took a long time choosing this leaf's underside.
The forest light does not reach here.
I tied a knot at the leaf stem.

lines.zh: 我不吵，也没人注意到我
lines.en: I am quiet; no one noticed me.

lines.zh: 我的丝是白色的，很显眼
lines.en: My silk is white and rather obvious.
A tree let me hang from it.
Waiting for one warm night.

lines.zh: 热透进来，里面全缩起来
lines.en: Heat comes through; everything inside contracts.

lines.zh: 我从叶上掉下去，落在落叶里
lines.en: I fall off the leaf into the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 水渗进壳里，我喘不上气
lines.en: Water seeps in and I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 气浪把丝扯断，我飞出去
lines.en: The blast snaps the silk and I fly off.
An arrow pierces one side of the shell.

lines.zh: 一股暖流扫过，我抖得厉害
lines.en: A warm current sweeps over me and I shudder.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，这不影响我
lines.en: I do not eat; this does not affect me.
Lightning lights the whole leaf.

lines.zh: 叶子没有了，我一直往下
lines.en: The leaf is gone; I keep falling.
